correctness.rationale: Independent same-arm arclength distance density is 2(a-t)_+ per arm; for two distinct arms it is the triangular-convolution hinge t_+-(t-a)_+-(t-b)_++(t-a-b)_+ per orientation. Summing proves (L²/2)f(t)=L + n(n-3)t/2 -(n-2)Σ(t-a_i)_++Σ_{i<j}(t-a_i-a_j)_+. Thus f(0)=2/L, L²f′(0+)=n(n-3), and the latter strictly determines n≥3. Distributional curvature ν=−(n−2)Σδ_ai+Σ_{i<j}δ_{ai+aj}. If two sorted multisets first differ at smallest positive s, pair sums at s involve only smaller positive lengths already equal, so coefficient difference is −(n−2) times multiplicity difference, impossible. The signed-atom peeling algorithm repeatedly subtracts contributions from already recovered arms and recovers all multiplicities. Independently reconstructed exact-rational curvature/peeling for 1,2,3 (the invisible third arm), equal arms, ties and longer examples; examined actual verify.py (exact rational hinge vs conditioning and simulations). These finite examples supplement, not replace, the strict-smallest-difference proof.
